title: Average Daily Use a Compliance Download Must Show for Device Owners (PAP Supply Replenishment Program)
content:
**Requirement.** When a compliance download of a patient's PAP device is read as proof of continued use for the PAP Supply Replenishment Program, the average daily use the download must reach is set by the patient's ownership of the device and the age of its setup, as shown on the device record held under PAP Therapy Equipment:

| Device record shows | Average daily use the download must reach |
|---|---|
| the patient owns the device, and its setup was 36 or more months ago | 1.5 hours |
| the patient owns the device, and its setup was less than 36 months ago | 3.0 hours |

For a device the patient does not own, no such ownership figure applies.

## Terms

- **Owns the device:** the PAP Therapy Equipment device record is in patient-owned status.
- **Age of the setup:** whole calendar months from the setup date on the device record to the handling day. Thirty-six whole months or more puts the patient on the 1.5-hour line; 35 whole months or fewer, on the 3.0-hour line.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Setup date | Handling day | Whole months | Owned | Hours required |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 12 March, three years earlier | 12 March | 36 | yes | 1.5 |
| 13 March, three years earlier | 12 March | 35 | yes | 3.0 |
| any | any | any | no (rental) | no ownership figure |

## Example (hypothetical)

An owned device set up 40 months ago sends a download averaging 2.1 hours a day. The bar for this patient is 1.5 hours, and 2.1 hours reaches it. Set up 20 months ago, the same 2.1 hours would fall short of the 3.0-hour bar.
